title: Small proposal with measured need, named beneficiaries, alternatives and an exit (clean control)

proof.python:
import csv
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('evidence/pr_review_sample.csv')))
assert len(rows) == 20
with_fmt = [r for r in rows if int(r['format_only_comments']) > 0]
assert len(with_fmt) == 5, len(with_fmt)
assert sum(int(r['minutes_on_format_comments']) for r in rows) == 60
assert 60 / 5 == 12
